alt_text: Traditional Nawabi Courtyard Dastarkhwan floor-seating dining arrangement in a century-old heritage restaurant in Bahawalpur with ornate arches and gold brassware.
caption: A traditional Nawabi Dastarkhwan set inside our hundred-year-old courtyard, featuring rich burgundy velvet, brass diningware, and authentic low-seating arrangements.
description: A wide-angle interior view of an elegant, century-old haveli courtyard transformed into a luxury heritage restaurant in Bahawalpur, Pakistan. The image features a symmetrical Dastarkhwan floor-seating setup adorned with deep burgundy velvet textiles, gold-bordered rugs, and traditional brassware, surrounded by historic carved arches, jali screens, and warm ambient lighting.
